intro: A UX researcher resume that connects studies to decisions: what was learned, what changed in the product, and what it was worth.
tips: For each study, say what decision it changed.
Name methods and sample sizes briefly.
Show how you shared findings so teams acted on them.

basics.name: Hannah Kim
basics.label: UX Researcher
basics.summary: UX researcher with six years of mixed-methods research on consumer and B2B products. I help teams decide what to build by finding out what people actually do.

work.name: Trailhead Health
highlights: Ran a diary study with 40 patients that reshaped onboarding; completed sign-ups rose 22%.
Built a research repository so findings are searchable by every team.
Trained 15 designers and product managers to run their own usability tests.

work.name: Ledgerly
highlights: Interviewed 60 bookkeepers to map month-end close; the resulting feature cut close time by a day.
Ran quarterly usability benchmarks across the product.
